allBugs.symptom: Static file server fallback served index.html on .env or sensitive file requests
allBugs.rootCause: !path.extname('/.env') treated dotfile as extensionless SPA route
allBugs.appliedFix: Added global dotfile and sensitive directory shield (pathname.startsWith('/.') -> HTTP 403)

allBugs.symptom: Windows EPERM error on concurrent fs.renameSync temp-file write
allBugs.rootCause: File lock retained momentarily by reader stream on Windows OS
allBugs.appliedFix: Enforce direct atomic synchronous fs.writeFileSync with retry wrapper
